project.name: plumb-ai
project.description:
R-? Step 7 — Slim agent framework used by plumb-style and plumb-dfa checkers (and the runner in plumb-main) to ask an LLM to judge a finding.
Contains: * agent/ — ReAct framework (LlmProvider interface, LlmMessage, LlmReply, ToolCall, ToolResult, ToolDefinition, AgentTask, AgentResult, ReActAgent, OpenAiCompatibleLlmProvider, LlmConnection) * tools/ — 12 Claude Code-style tools (read_source, grep, glob, list_dir, search_pattern, find_definitions, find_callers, has_sanitizer_on_path, get_method_annotations, get_class_hierarchy, get_full_class, get_dataflow_trace_with_facts) * prompts/AgentPrompts — system prompts for the two agents (FP reducer, bug scanner). The rule-specific knowledge lives on each checker's getAiPrompt(Finding) method.
No dependency on plumb-dfa: the per-rule prompts are owned by the checkers, not by plumb-ai.
